component.name: MeshDrive
component.summary: Local-first Linux storage with TUI and optional AI tools

description.p: MeshDrive is a local-first storage agent for Linux. It keeps files on your disks with JuiceFS (SQLite metadata + local object store), provides a Textual terminal UI for setup, and serves a loopback Filebrowser UI.

Free add-ons include MCP for AI tools, OpenFGA authorization, and local OpenTelemetry files. A paid license unlocks WireGuard hub-spoke mesh, LDAP via SSSD, remote JuiceFS, and VIX gateway/FUSE — over WireGuard, not ZeroTier.

The Flatpak runs the CLI and TUI in a sandbox with host filesystem and FUSE device access. Persistent state lives under the Flatpak app data directory. For full systemd unit integration on servers, prefer the Snap or Debian package.
Snap agent auto-start hooks; in-process mount/Filebrowser under snap.
Snap doctor and binary path fixes; JuiceFS/Filebrowser under $SNAP.
User↔bucket ACL, Filebrowser portals, TUI assign users and buckets.
MCP JuiceFS buckets, hybrid free→paid identity tooling, HTTPS license scaffolding, private/shared homes.
Initial Flatpak packaging for MeshDrive 2.0 (JuiceFS v1.4.1, Filebrowser v2.63.23).
